## Summary

Recorded as a follow-up opportunity by WL-0MSGHM5BQ0096BNJ (Herdr worklist: mouse and touch support in the selection list): implement drag-to-scroll (touch drag on touch devices / click-drag on desktop terminals) for the selection list and detail view. Explicitly OUT OF SCOPE of the parent; this item exists so the opportunity is not lost.

discovered-from:WL-0MSGHM5BQ0096BNJ

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] (placeholder — to be refined during intake/planning) Touch drag scrolls the list/detail content proportionally to finger movement; drag-release does not trigger a click
- [ ] Click-drag on desktop (where supported) scrolls without moving the selection; drag-motion does not jump the selection
- [ ] Keyboard and click/tap behaviors from WL-0MSGHM5BQ0096BNJ remain unchanged
- [ ] Full project test suite passes

## Notes

- Depends on the parent's mouse parsing/dispatch foundation (WL-0MSI720DX002E9WC, WL-0MSI7278X0008XGM, WL-0MSI72EYW00050N2)
- Must respect the drag-motion guard (button 32 motion bit) already specified in the parent

data.description:
## Problem

The `herdr-podcast-editor` plugin is linked in herdr but its manifest is unavailable — it points at /home/rgardler/projects/open_source_llm/experimental/herdr-podcast-editor/herdr-plugin.toml which no longer exists:

- `herdr plugin list` output: 'herdr-podcast-editor (herdr-podcast-editor) enabled [local:...experimental/herdr-podcast-editor; 1 warning(s)] ... warning: manifest unavailable: No such file or directory (os error 2)'

The project was presumably moved/deleted; all herdr elements of the plugin must be removed.

## Scope (verify each)

- [ ] Unlink the plugin: `herdr plugin unlink herdr-podcast-editor` (or via registry)
- [ ] Confirm ~/.config/herdr/plugins.json no longer contains a herdr-podcast-editor entry
- [ ] Check ~/.config/herdr/plugins/config/herdr-podcast-editor/ for leftover config and remove if present
- [ ] Check for any keybindings referencing herdr-podcast-editor actions in ~/.config/herdr/config.toml and remove
- [ ] Check for plugin-owned panes/logs (e.g. herdr plugin log / pane management) referencing herdr-podcast-editor
- [ ] Verify `herdr plugin list` shows no herdr-podcast-editor entry and no warnings remain
- [ ] Confirm the worklog-selection-list plugin still works afterwards (no collateral damage)

## Notes

- If the plugin dir still exists somewhere, reconsider (re-link vs remove) — but the experimental dir is gone, so removal is the expected outcome.
- Keep changes to herdr config minimal; do not touch unrelated plugins.

Discovered from: support session 2026-08-13 (prefix+l not working — dangling worklog-selection-list manifest; noticed herdr-podcast-editor had the same dangling-manifest warning).
Session: 019ffad5-8406-7ff2-bcac-c25cc77c3e70
data.title: Remove all elements of herdr-podcast-editor plugin

data.comment:
Auto-plan completed with review: effort and risk below threshold. No new child features created — existing two linter findings are self-contained and ready to implement directly.

Review summary (six automated stages):
1. Requirements & AC alignment — Parent epic has no explicit ACs; generic 'closed when children resolved' contract is vacuous for coverage. No new ACs invented; outstanding producer question recorded below. (pass)
2. Completeness — Parent description + 2 children present. No Key Files section; children each reference a single file/line/linter code. Both children have intake_complete stage and actionable finding details. (pass)
3. Sequencing & dependencies — No dep edges between children; both are independent (different files/linter rules). No reordering or test-before-implementation split needed at this granularity. (pass)
4. Scope sizing — 2 small, independent lint fixes; each child is already a minimal end-to-end slice (run ruff -- fix -- verify). No further decomposition warranted. (pass — no-op)
5. Acceptance & testability — Child ACs are pass/fail: ruff check exits 0 for the targeted file/line/code. Testability is via ruff invocation, not custom tests. (pass)
6. Polish & handoff — Epic description clear and copy-pasteable. Children titles include file:line and linter code. No reformatting needed. (pass)

AC coverage review: recommendation=proceed (parent_acs=[], coverage 100%, no gaps/conflicts).

Note: One child references scripts/audit_runner.py which does not exist on current HEAD — implementers should verify before closing (see Open Question).
